sections.text: Space exploration is the application of physics, engineering, and systems design to put objects and humans beyond Earth's atmosphere. The physics is orbital mechanics and propulsion; the engineering is reliability under extreme conditions; the systems challenge is the hardest integration problem humans routinely tackle.
